name: Credit Score Estimator API
shortDescription: Transparent credit-score estimate from the public FICO category weights — score band + per-factor breakdown + improvement plan
description: Agent-native credit-score estimator computed from the publicly documented FICO category weights (payment history 35%, utilization 30%, length 15%, mix 10%, new credit 10%) and mapped to the 300–850 scale. /estimate returns an estimated score, an uncertainty band (±20), a rating, and a per-factor breakdown with each factor's sub-score and impact. The one-call /lookup adds a prioritized improvement plan, reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and assumptions. A deterministic MODEL and explicit estimate — not your actual FICO/VantageScore — so confidence is intentionally below 1.0. No fabrication: every sub-score derives from your inputs.

name: Insurance Needs Calculator API
shortDescription: Deterministic life-insurance needs via the DIME method — total need, coverage gap, and recommended coverage
description: Agent-native life-insurance needs calculator computed with the DIME method (Debt + Income replacement + Mortgage + Education) plus final expenses, netted against existing coverage and liquid assets. /calculate returns the DIME breakdown, total need, coverage gap, a recommended coverage amount (rounded to 25k), a 10×-income cross-check, and an adequately_insured flag. The one-call /lookup adds an income-horizon sensitivity table, reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and assumptions. Real arithmetic — confidence always 1.0; every response carries a financial_disclaimer.

name: Loan Affordability Calculator API
shortDescription: Deterministic max loan & home price from income, DTI caps, rate and term — identifies the binding constraint
description: Agent-native loan/home affordability calculator computed in real amortization math. /calculate applies the standard 28% front-end and 36% back-end DTI caps to your income, nets out existing debt and taxes/insurance, and inverts the amortization formula to the maximum loan amount and purchase price — and names the binding constraint. The one-call /lookup adds a rate-sensitivity table (±1%), reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and assumptions. Confidence always 1.0; every response carries a financial_disclaimer.

name: Rent vs Buy Calculator API
shortDescription: Deterministic rent-vs-buy comparison over a horizon — net cost each way, recommendation, and break-even year
description: Agent-native rent-vs-buy calculator computed in real math. /compare models the net cost of buying (mortgage + taxes + insurance + maintenance − equity recovered at sale) against renting (rent growth − investment gain on the cash a buyer ties up) over a holding horizon, returning a recommendation, the cost difference, a full buy/rent breakdown, and the break-even year. The one-call /lookup adds an appreciation-sensitivity table (±2%), reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and explicit assumptions (it is assumption-heavy by nature). Confidence always 1.0; every response carries a financial_disclaimer.

name: DTI Calculator API
shortDescription: Deterministic debt-to-income ratios — front/back-end DTI, lender qualification band, and headroom to 36%/43%
description: Agent-native debt-to-income calculator computed in pure arithmetic. /calculate returns the front-end (housing) and back-end (total debt) DTI ratios against gross income, maps the back-end ratio to a lender qualification band (strong/acceptable/limited/high-risk), and reports how much additional monthly debt fits before the 36% and 43% limits. The one-call /lookup adds the standard threshold table, reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators), and assumptions. Confidence always 1.0; every response carries a financial_disclaimer.
